name: ext_metrics_pairs
purpose: RQ4.1 pair-level error characterisation (by true lag of the pair's direct edge and by role relative to the damaged edges) and RQ4.4 truth-free flags for tolerant_v4. Re-runs the a2_baselines / a2b_pselect seeds exactly, storing pair-level rows. Run by experiments/ext/metrics/run_pairs.py, not by run_experiment.py (which stores run-level medians only).
